narrative: It's been a little over a week since I got back from the National Day trip, and I've spent most of it writing the trip down: first an overview, then the morning, midday and afternoon of the day in Moscow. The two hours of Turkish bath underground in Göreme has a first draft too, except the hammam and massage parts at the end, which I haven't had the energy to fill in yet.
